sloka: बिभीषणमथोवाच राक्षसेन्द्रं महायशाः ।यावत्प्रजा धरिष्यन्ति तावत्त्वं वै बिभीषण ।राक्षसेन्द्र महावीर्य लङ्कास्थस्त्वं धरिष्यसि ।। ७.१०८.२७ ॥
transliteration: bibhīṣaṇamathovāca rākṣasendraṁ mahāyaśāḥ ।yāvatprajā dhariṣyanti tāvattvaṁ vai bibhīṣaṇa ।rākṣasendra mahāvīrya laṅkāsthastvaṁ dhariṣyasi ।। 7.108.27 ॥

translations.english: The greatly renowned Rama then spoke to Vibhishana, the king of Rakshasas, declaring that as long as people exist, Vibhishana, the greatly valorous king of Rakshasas residing in Lanka, would indeed endure and rule.
